Report actual generated backend/frontend paths and extension hooks so disjoint workers can proceed. Do not implement final domain features, run full tests/builds, seed users or start servers. Ignore local secrets, node_modules and .qualification outputs. Return at most 250 words: version/commands, generated interfaces, ownership boundaries and any blocker. Do not delegate tasks; return the assigned scoped result.
